body: You can provide a function to the [sortBy](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets/hierarchicalMenu.html#struct-HierarchicalMenuWidgetOptions-sortBy) parameter. This provided function should be like a [compare function](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array/sort#Description). Let us know if that helps you.
